title: Ralph McQuarrie
description: RALPH MCQUARRIE provided much of the conceptual art for the STAR WARS trilogy, and he was also responsible for the production art, or paintings that depict key scenes from the script. Here, in action from RETURN OF THE JEDI, a Gamorrean guard marches Artoo and Threepio into a boiler room-turned droid torture chamber presided over by EV-9D9, a seven-foot tall, reed-thin and  human-like robot who heads Jabba's Cyborg Operations.
